title: Project page brief
description: The outward-facing read-me a project delivers to jameskidd.info. Lives in the project's own repo at docs/jameskidd.info.md, written by that repo's agents when told "create a project page brief for jameskidd.info". The site fetches it (scripts/sync-briefs.mjs), validates it against this schema and the body rules in docs/project-brief.md, snapshots it under src/content/projects/briefs/<slug>.mdx, and publishes it once James stamps it. Frontmatter only; the body rules are in docs/project-brief.md.

slug.description: Must equal the slug of the site's project record (src/content/projects/<slug>.mdx).

summary.description: One line, plain text, no Markdown.

url.description: The project's own site, if it has one.

updated.description: The day this brief was last rewritten, YYYY-MM-DD.

image.description: Absolute URL only; the site hosts nothing for a project.

source.description: Set by the site's sync (scripts/sync-briefs.mjs): where the snapshot was fetched from. A project never sets it.
